guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails to build due to a 404 Not Found error when trying to download Miniconda installer script https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-py39_23.7.2-1-Linux-x86_64.sh. The specified version 'Miniconda3-py39_23.7.2-1-Linux-x86_64.sh' does not exist on the official repo at the time of build. To fix this, update the Miniconda installer URL to a valid existing Miniconda Linux x86_64 installer for Python 3.9 that is currently available. You can check https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/ for available installer names or use a stable earlier version like Miniconda3-py39_4.12.0-Linux-x86_64.sh or the latest Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh if allowed by compatibility. Without this fix, the environment setup will fail and tests cannot run.
